verdict.rationale: Pipecat's telephony docs cover per-call webhook-driven session handling (inbound/outbound single calls via Twilio/Telnyx/etc.) and unlimited concurrency on Pipecat Cloud, but there is no evidence of batch campaign management, call scheduling, pacing/throughput controls, or dialer-list orchestration for outbound campaigns — this is a fair ask for a telephony-capable voice AI framework but no such capability is documented.
